entry.k: Earth-838's Sorcerer Supreme, of the Illuminati
st: Mordo greets the visiting Strange as a brother, then drugs him and America Chavez and delivers them to the Illuminati.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

entry.k: A Deadpool variant who serves Cassandra Nova
st: Ladypool comes with the Deadpool variants Cassandra Nova summons to stall Wade and Logan, and they gun down Nicepool.
Logan cuts her down in the brawl, but she heals and joins the variants cheering Peter as Wade and Logan slip away.

entry.k: Deadpool variants who serve Cassandra Nova
st: Cassandra Nova summons a crowd of Deadpool variants to stall Wade and Logan in Wade's world, and they gun down Nicepool.
Wade and Logan cut through them, but the variants heal, and stop fighting only to cheer for Peter.
